title: SeatGeek × Ex-Grubhub | People who know marketplaces
intro: Why this network for SeatGeek? Grubhub and SeatGeek both depend on high-volume consumer journeys, reliable transaction systems, partner operations and exceptional experiences when something goes wrong. These six professionals have operated in parts of that environment. Each introduction below explains the specific transferable experience, the SeatGeek problem it could help solve, and the remaining fit question. These are editorial recommendations—not endorsements or confirmed applications.

items.note: Eduardo has led consumer product engineering teams of up to 36 and modernized 30+ services. SeatGeek's enterprise platform requires leaders who can evolve complex systems while maintaining reliability for venues and fans. His experience connects modernization with operational delivery. Verify director-level scope and location.

items.role: Lead Product Manager, Fan Experience · Remote US
items.note: Connor has built API and platform products from concept through launch. SeatGeek's fan journey depends on coordination across discovery, checkout and integrations, not just the interface. He brings a valuable systems-oriented product perspective. Validate direct consumer conversion and experimentation ownership.

Elena has led complex enterprise onboarding, implementation and escalation work for major brands. SeatGeek's clients need reliable technical rollouts and responsive cross-functional support. Her strength is making difficult operational processes work. Confirm commercial account ownership, travel expectations and ticketing-specific needs.

items.role: Engineering Manager, Core Engineering · Remote US
items.note: Mike has led consumer search and discovery engineering alongside shared platforms and teams of up to 45. For SeatGeek, speed, availability and relevant discovery influence fan experience and conversion. He understands the intersection of product and platform reliability. Validate core infrastructure depth and technical stack.

Daniel spent 13+ years building and leading Grubhub mobile and post-purchase experiences. SeatGeek's fan experience continues after checkout, when tickets, changes and support can become urgent. He understands engineering behind time-sensitive marketplace operations. Confirm SupportX technical scope and leadership expectations.

items.role: Lead Product Manager, Fan Experience · New York
items.note: Paul combines technical product management, decision science, AI product delivery and integrations. SeatGeek could benefit from that mix when reducing friction and improving fan experiences. His differentiator is translating technical possibilities into products, rather than direct ticketing expertise. Confirm consumer PM outcomes and location.
